codes.summary: No phrase matches the sentence by its shape.
codes.text:
A sentence matches a phrase when it has the same number of items and the same words in the same places. A hole takes exactly one item, so a sentence of several words must be inside parentheses. If nothing matches, you get `unknown-phrase`. It is also the error for an event phrase that stands outside `when`, a record field that does not exist, and a `message … with` setting of more than two items.

A common cause is a missing pair of parentheses. Here `if` takes one condition, and `n.Role is "leader"` is three items.

files.p/p.synod:
# package p
Node has
  set Role to "follower"

define [n: Node] Demote
  if n.Role is "leader"
    set n.Role to "follower"

codes.diagnostic:
p/p.synod:6:3: error[unknown-phrase]: no phrase matches "if n.Role is "leader""
  hint: did you mean "if (n.Role is "leader")"?

files.p/p.synod:
# package p
Node has
  set Role to "follower"

define [n: Node] Demote
  if (n.Role is "leader")
    set n.Role to "follower"
